resources.string: Delete the route \"%1$s\"? Its %2$d Big Flowers will be deleted too. This can\'t be undone.

Turn off to save battery. The vibration motor uses more power than the mock location itself, and the more Big Flowers on your route, the bigger the effect. You\'ll still get notifications when it\'s off.
When you pass several Big Flowers in a row, wait at least this long before vibrating again.
After the set number of laps, walk back to your real location and turn off the mock automatically. Enter 0 for no limit, until you tap \"Go home\" yourself.
